study_identification_part.si_4_title: Spectral normative modeling of brain structure

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: HCP Development, HCP Young Adult, and HCP Aging cohorts; MACC clinical dataset (Memory, Ageing & Cognition Centre at the National University of Singapore).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "This study uses three publicly available healthy brain imaging datasets that were provided and curated by the Human Connectome Project (HCP) 101 ; namely, HCP's Young Adult 102 , Aging 103 , and Development 104 cohorts." "...we evaluated the model's translational capabilities to real-world data from memory clinics (Memory, Ageing & Cognition Centre at the National University of Singapore: MACC)"

answer.Unknown: clinical transfer learning and evaluation (MACC memory clinic sample)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Healthy HCP cohorts were split into train/test for normative model fitting and validation; the MACC clinical dataset was used for translational evaluation and fine-tuning via transfer learning.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "In addition to the healthy datasets used to train the normative model, we evaluated the model's translational capabilities to real-world data from memory clinics (Memory, Ageing & Cognition Centre at the National University of Singapore: MACC)" "80% ( N train =1978 individuals) of the healthy data were used to train the model, and the remaining 20% ( N test =495) were used for out-of-sample validation" "The normative model, pre-trained on N train healthy individuals, was subsequently fine-tuned for the clinical sample of N MACC = 674 individuals using transfer learning."
